details: 1.0.63 Linux: reply to PROGRAM was 'T^@^@^@^@^@^@^_^ST^PROGRAM' (26 bytes) instead of QX 06. Caret notation is a Linux terminal echo, so ttyACM0 is not answering as the radio (wrong device, a getty/ModemManager on the port, or an echoing cable).
summary: PROGRAM comes back echoed in terminal caret notation on /dev/ttyACM0
